interpretation: Scale normalization re-fits rigid translation at observed floor centroid: for b=s R a+t, re-fit is t+(s-1)median(Ra). Similarity translation is an extrapolation to camera origin and is not automatically true metric camera motion. Incorrect plane/height or nonrigid carpet can bias both; accepted scale within3percent is not proof of metric calibration.

coordinate_review.planar_state: For old-to-new floor point transform b=R a+t, camera displacement in previous frame is -R.T t; world rotation by -accumulated yaw is consistent with this coordinate convention. No sign/inversion bug identified.
coordinate_review.camera_correction: For camera down d=-M*u, premultiplying M by a proper orthonormal Q mapping d_current to d_visual yields desired normal. One direction does not identify yaw about gravity.
coordinate_review.scope: Floor slope and mounting error are not distinguishable from one local planar scene. Preserve global imu_mount.json; use candidate local plane correction only for bounded current-patch validation. A constant camera-frame Q does not model a sloped floor correctly over arbitrary robot yaw.
coordinate_review.guards: route_executor, spatial_turn and object_mission compare IMU-frame up to initial up. Camera-plane correction must not change this reference or five-degree threshold.
coordinate_review.next: Compare independent held-out target range change and near/far floor displacement on a short straight route, with fresh normal evidence before heading changes.
